outbreakIDs.description: Available outbreaks for this client. Not present/empty array means that all outbreaks are available. Not used by the keys of other Go.Data instances (type instance): they ask for each outbreak

type.description: instance: another Go.Data instance, that asks to send each outbreak (the outbreaks are accepted / refused here); mobile: the mobile app (or an older key), limited by outbreakIDs

autoAcceptSameIdOutbreaks.description: Keys of other instances: accept automatically the outbreaks that exist in this instance with the same id

senderSyncInterval.description: Keys of other instances: hours between the syncs of the instance (0: only manually); told by the instance when it syncs

senderSyncEnabled.description: Keys of other instances: the instance has its syncs enabled; told by the instance when it syncs

senderScheduleReportedAt.description: Keys of other instances: when the instance told when it syncs

lastSyncAt.description: When data was sent with this key the last time

lastSyncStatus.description: Status of the last data sent with this key

prototype.downloadConfigurationFile.description: Generate and download a (QR-Code) PNG file containing client application configuration.
